test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight lawyers with the initials A, K, L, M, N, O, P and Q were sitting around a square table and were facing the centre. Four of them were sitting at the corners, while the other four were at the exact centre of the sides. L, at a corner, was to the immediate right of M and was diagonally opposite to A. Q, sitting at a corner, was next to both M and K. P was second to the left of A. N was not sitting diagonally opposite to M. Which lawyer was second to the left of K?
solution: Eight lawyers: A, K, L, M, N, O, P, and Q They are sitting around a square table and facing the center. Four of them were sitting at the corners, while the other four were at the exact center of the sides. 1) L, at a corner, was to the immediate right of M 2) L was diagonally opposite to A.
